Result: "---\nname: sdl-handling\ndescription: 'AMI System Description Language (SDL) handling for new driver/module integration and DSC/FDF diff porting. Covers INFComponent, LIBRARYMAPPING, PcdMapping, FFS_FILE, ELINK, TOKEN, and FD_AREA SDL objects. Use when integrating new modules or porting DSC/FDF changes from silicon vendor RC into AMI BIOS source trees.'\nargument-hint: '[INF file path, module name, or DSC/FDF diff context]'\n---\n\n# SDL Handling for RC Integration\n\nThis skill provides exact SDL syntax, porting rules, and decision logic for:\n1. Creating SDL entries for new INF modules (orphan handling)\n2. Translating DSC diff changes into SDL updates\n3. Translating FDF diff changes into SDL updates\n\nThe full AMI SDL specification is at [AMI_SDL_Specification.md](./AMI_SDL_Specification.md).\n\n> **All syntax below is verified against real AMI SDL files — field names and formats are exact.**\n\n---\n\n## SDL Object Quick Reference\n\n### INFComponent — Register an EDK II INF Module\n\n```\nINFComponent\n    Name        = \"ModuleBaseName\"         # unique name; referenced by LIBRARYMAPPING and FFS_FILE\n    File        = \"SubDir/Module.inf\"      # path relative to Package root (NOT full BIOS path)\n    Package     = \"PkgName\"               # EDK II package name\n    Arch        = \"X64\"                   # IA32 | X64 | ARM | AARCH64 | \"IA32 X64\"  (optional)\n    ModuleTypes = \"DXE_DRIVER\"            # PLURAL — never Module_Type\n    Path        = \"NAMED_PATH_ALIAS\"      # named path alias from PATH SDL object (optional)\n    Token       = \"FLAG\" \"=\" \"1\"          # three separate quoted strings: name, operator, value\nEnd\n```\n\n**Critical field rules:**\n- `ModuleTypes` is **plural** — never `Module_Type`\n- `Arch` is **optional** — omit if all architectures are supported\n- `Path` is a **named alias** (e.g. `\"SB_INIT_DIR\"`), not a filesystem path\n- `Token` condition = **three quoted strings**: `\"TOKEN_NAME\" \"OPERATOR\" \"VALUE\"`\n\n**Arch values from INF VALID_ARCHITECTURES:**\n- `X64` → `Arch = \"X64\"`\n- `IA32 X64` → `Arch = \"IA32 X64\"`\n- `IA32` → `Arch = \"IA32\"`\n- Not restricted / common → omit `Arch`\n\n---\n\n### LIBRARYMAPPING — Map Library Class to Implementation\n\n```\nLIBRARYMAPPING\n    Class       = \"LibraryClassName\"                # library class name from INF/DSC\n    Instance    = \"Package.INFComponentName\"        # dot-separated \"Package.Name\" format\n    ModuleTypes = \"PEIM\"                            # PLURAL; scope to module type (optional)\n    Arch        = \"IA32 X64\"                        # optional; space-separated architectures\n    Token       = \"FLAG\" \"=\" \"1\"                    # three quoted strings (optional)\nEnd\n```\n\n**Critical field rules:**\n- `Instance` uses **`\"Package.ComponentName\"`** dot-separated format — never just the base name\n- `ModuleTypes` is **plural** — never `Module_Type` (NDA field-table uses `Module_Type` but real Aptio V SDL uses `ModuleTypes`)\n- `Arch` is **optional** — present in real SDL files when architecture-scoping is needed; do NOT flag its presence as an error\n- No `Override` field — module-scoped library overrides are handled via `ModuleTypes` scoping\n\n---\n\n### PcdMapping — Declare a Platform Configuration Database Entry\n\n```\nPcdMapping\n    Name      = \"PcdName\"\n    GuidSpace = \"gXxxTokenSpaceGuid\"         # field is GuidSpace — NOT Guid\n    PcdType   = \"PcdsFixedAtBuild\"           # full EDK II section name WITH \"Pcds\" prefix\n    DataType  = \"BOOLEAN\"                    # CamelCase — NOT Data_Type\n    Value     = \"TRUE\"\n    Offset    = 00h                          # hex, required\n    Length    = 001h                         # hex, required\n    TargetDSC = Yes                          # emit to generated PLATFORM_DSC\n    Help      = \"Description\"               # optional\n    Token     = \"FLAG\" \"=\" \"1\"              # three quoted strings (optional)\nEnd\n```\n\n**Critical field rules:**\n- Object keyword is `PcdMapping` — **mixed case**, not `PCDMAPPING`\n- `GuidSpace` — **not** `Guid`\n- `PcdType` — **not** `Pcd_Type`; value includes full `\"Pcds\"` prefix\n- `DataType` — **not** `Data_Type`; use `\"Pointer\"` for `VOID*` string PCDs\n- `Offset` and `Length` — required fields in hex format\n\n**PcdType values (full EDK II section names):**\n\n| DSC Section | PcdType value |\n|---|---|\n| `[PcdsFeatureFlag]` | `\"PcdsFeatureFlag\"` |\n| `[PcdsFixedAtBuild]` | `\"PcdsFixedAtBuild\"` |\n| `[PcdsPatchableInModule]` | `\"PcdsPatchableInModule\"` |\n| `[PcdsDynamicDefault]` | `\"PcdsDynamicDefault\"` |\n| `[PcdsDynamicEx]` | `\"PcdsDynamicEx\"` |\n| `[PcdsDynamicHii]` | `\"PcdsDynamicHii\"` |\n| `[PcdsDynamicVpd]` | `\"PcdsDynamicVpd\"` |\n\n---\n\n### FFS_FILE — Place Module in a Firmware Volume\n\n```\nFFS_FILE\n    Name          = \"ModuleBaseNameFfs\"             # convention: append \"Ffs\"\n    FD_AREA       = \"FV_MAIN\"                       # must match an FD_AREA.Name in SDL\n    INFComponent  = \"Package.INFComponentName\"      # dot-separated \"Package.Name\" format\n    Index         = \"1\"                             # quoted integer OR '\"BEFORE\" \"OtherFfsName\"' / '\"AFTER\" \"OtherFfsName\"'\n    Apriori_Index = \"9\"                             # QUOTED string — not a bare integer\n    Help          = \"Optional description\"\n    Token         = \"FLAG\" \"=\" \"1\"                  # three quoted strings (optional)\nEnd\n```\n\n**For non-INF FFS entries (RAW binary, FREEFORM):**\n```\nFFS_FILE\n    Name      = \"SomeBinaryFfs\"\n    FD_AREA   = \"FV_BB\"\n    FILE_Stmt = \"AmiChipsetModulePkg/LegacyRom/Xhci/XhciRecoveryFirmware.txt\"\n    Token     = \"XHCI_RECOVERY_PATH_MODE\" \"=\" \"1\"\nEnd\n```\n\n**Critical field rules:**\n- `INFComponent` uses **`\"Package.ComponentName\"`** format — never just the base name\n- `Apriori_Index` is a **quoted string** — never a bare integer\n- **`Module_Type` is mutually exclusive with `INFComponent`, `File_Stmt`, and `OpRom`** (NDA spec) — when `INFComponent` is present (the normal case in Aptio V), `Module_Type` must be absent; do NOT flag this absence as a missing field\n- Multiple `Token` lines are AND-ed together\n\n**FV placement by MODULE_TYPE:**\n\n| MODULE_TYPE | FD_AREA |\n|---|---|\n| `SEC` | `FV_BB` |\n| `PEI_CORE`, `PEIM` | `FV_BB` or `FV_MAIN_PEI` |\n| `DXE_CORE`, `DXE_DRIVER`, `DXE_RUNTIME_DRIVER` | `FV_MAIN` |\n| `DXE_SMM_DRIVER` | `FV_MAIN` |\n| `UEFI_DRIVER` | `FV_MAIN` |\n| `UEFI_APPLICATION` | Exclude unless explicitly required |\n\n---\n\n### TOKEN — Define a Build-Time Configuration Value\n\n```\nTOKEN\n    Name      = \"FEATURE_NAME\"\n    Value     = \"1\"\n    Help      = \"Brief description of what this token controls\"\n    TokenType = Boolean               # Boolean | Integer  (unquoted)\n    TargetH   = Yes                   # emit #define to TOKEN.H   (C headers)\n    TargetMAK = Yes                   # emit to TOKEN.MAK          (nmake)\n    TargetEQU = Yes                   # emit to TOKEN.EQU          (ASM equates)\n    TargetASL = Yes                   # emit to TOKENS.ASL         (ACPI ASL)\n    Lock      = Yes                   # prevent SDL Wizard edits (optional)\n    Master    = Yes                   # master token — ONE per project only (optional)\n    Range     = \"0-1\"                 # valid value range (optional)\n    Token     = \"PARENT_FLAG\" \"=\" \"1\" # dependency condition (optional)\nEnd\n```\n\n**Target field guide:**\n\n| TokenType | Typical targets |\n|---|---|\n| `Boolean` | `TargetH = Yes` |\n| `Integer` | `TargetH = Yes`, `TargetMAK = Yes`, `TargetEQU = Yes` |\n| ASL-only | `TargetASL = Yes` |\n\n**Critical field rules:**\n- `TokenType` uses unquoted `Boolean` or `Integer` for hand-authored tokens; auto-generated tokens may use quoted `\"Boolean\"`\n- `Token` dependency condition — **three quoted strings**: `\"NAME\" \"OPERATOR\" \"VALUE\"`\n- `Master = Yes` — only one allowed per project; never duplicate\n\n---\n\n### ELINK — Register an Initialization Hook\n\n```\nELINK\n    Name        = \"FunctionName,\"         # TRAILING COMMA — C initializer list syntax\n    Parent      = \"ParentRoutineName\"\n    Priority    = 10                      # order among siblings (lower = runs first)\n    InvokeOrder = AfterParent             # AfterParent | BeforeParent\n    Arch        = \"X64\"                   # optional\n    Token       = \"FLAG\" \"=\" \"1\"          # three quoted strings (optional)\nEnd\n```\n\n**Critical field rules:**\n- `Name` ends with a **trailing comma** — it is inserted into a C comma-separated function pointer list\n- `Priority` controls execution order among sibling ELINKs\n- `InvokeOrder` controls position relative to the parent function call\n\n---\n\n## Token Condition Syntax — Universal Rule\n\n**Every SDL object** uses the same three-quoted-string format for conditional inclusion:\n\n```\nToken = \"TOKEN_NAME\" \"OPERATOR\" \"VALUE\"\n```\n\n| Operator string | Meaning |\n|---|---|\n| `\"=\"` | equal |\n| `\"!=\"` | not equal |\n| `\">=\"` | greater or equal |\n| `\"<=\"` | less or equal |\n| `\">\"` | greater than |\n| `\"<\"` | less than |\n\n**Multiple conditions** = multiple `Token` lines (ALL must be true — AND logic):\n```\nToken = \"FEATURE_A\" \"=\" \"1\"\nToken = \"PLATFORM_X\" \"!=\" \"0\"\n```\n\n**Else-branch** = second SDL object with inverse condition:\n```\nPcdMapping                          # DEBUG_MODE = 1 branch\n    Name      = \"PcdDebugPropertyMask\"\n    ...\n    Token     = \"DEBUG_MODE\" \"=\" \"1\"\nEnd\nPcdMapping                          # DEBUG_MODE = 0 branch\n    Name      = \"PcdDebugPropertyMask\"\n    ...\n    Token     = \"DEBUG_MODE\" \"=\" \"0\"\nEnd\n```\n\n---\n\n## DSC-to-SDL Translation Table\n\n| DSC Element | SDL Object | Key Field Mapping |\n|---|---|---|\n| `[LibraryClasses]` global | `LIBRARYMAPPING` | `Class` = lib name, `Instance` = `\"Pkg.CompName\"` |\n| `[LibraryClasses.common.DXE_DRIVER]` | `LIBRARYMAPPING` | + `ModuleTypes = \"DXE_DRIVER\"` |\n| `[Components]` INF entry | `INFComponent` + `FFS_FILE` | `Name` from BASE_NAME, `File` from INF path |\n| `[Components.X64]` | `INFComponent` | `Arch = \"X64\"` |\n| Component `<LibraryClasses>` override | `LIBRARYMAPPING` | `Instance = \"Pkg.CompName\"`, `ModuleTypes` scoped |\n| Component `<PcdsFixedAtBuild>` | `PcdMapping` | `PcdType = \"PcdsFixedAtBuild\"`, `TargetDSC = Yes` |\n| `[PcdsFixedAtBuild]` global | `PcdMapping` | `PcdType = \"PcdsFixedAtBuild\"`, `TargetDSC = Yes` |\n| `[PcdsDynamicDefault]` | `PcdMapping` | `PcdType = \"PcdsDynamicDefault\"` |\n| `[PcdsFeatureFlag]` | `PcdMapping` | `PcdType = \"PcdsFeatureFlag\"` |\n| `[PcdsDynamicHii]` | `PcdMapping` | `PcdType = \"PcdsDynamicHii\"` |\n| `!if $(FLAG) == 1` | `Token` line | `Token = \"FLAG\" \"=\" \"1\"` on affected SDL object |\n| `!ifdef FLAG` | `Token` line | `Token = \"FLAG\" \"=\" \"1\"` |\n| `!if $(A)==1 AND $(B)==1` | Two `Token` lines | One line per condition |\n| `!else` branch | Second SDL object | Inverse `Token` condition value |\n\n---\n\n## FDF-to-SDL Translation Table\n\n| FDF Element | SDL Object | Key Field Mapping |\n|---|---|---|\n| `[FV.FV_NAME]` section | `FD_AREA` | `Name = \"FV_NAME\"` |\n| `INF Pkg/Driver.inf` inside FV | `FFS_FILE` | `FD_AREA = \"FV_NAME\"`, `INFComponent = \"Pkg.Name\"` |\n| `APRIORI DXE { INF ... }` | `FFS_FILE` | + `Apriori_Index = \"N\"` (quoted string) |\n| `FILE RAW = {GUID} { SECTION RAW = f }` | `FFS_FILE` | `FILE_Stmt = \"path/to/file.txt\"` |\n| `SET gGuid.PcdName = Value` | `PcdMapping` or `TOKEN` | Update `Value` field |\n\n---\n\n## AMI Ownership Decision Logic\n\nBefore creating any SDL entry, always search AMI SDL first:\n\n```\nSearch AMI SDL for matching entry\n│\n├── FOUND\n│   ├── AMI value == OLD_RC value → AMI was tracking vendor → PORT to NEW_RC value\n│   └── AMI value != OLD_RC value → AMI has intentional customisation → PRESERVE AMI value\n│\n└── NOT FOUND → CREATE new SDL entry using NEW_RC value\n```\n\n---\n\n## FV Name Resolution (FV Names Don't Match)\n\nWhen NEW_RC FDF uses a different FV name than AMI:\n1. List INFs inside the vendor FV\n2. Search AMI SDL `FFS_FILE` for those INFs (via `INFComponent`)\n3. The `FD_AREA` on those existing entries = AMI's equivalent FV\n4. Use that AMI FV name for all new `FFS_FILE` entries\n\n---\n\n## Complete Token Condition Porting Example\n\n```\n# DSC !if guard:\n!if $(NEW_FEATURE_SUPPORT) == 1\n  SomePkg/SomeDriver/SomeDriver.inf\n!endif\n\n# → SDL INFComponent:\nINFComponent\n    Name        = \"SomeDriver\"\n    File        = \"SomeDriver/SomeDriver.inf\"\n    Package     = \"SomePkg\"\n    ModuleTypes = \"DXE_DRIVER\"\n    Token       = \"NEW_FEATURE_SUPPORT\" \"=\" \"1\"\nEnd\n\n# → SDL FFS_FILE:\nFFS_FILE\n    Name         = \"SomeDriverFfs\"\n    FD_AREA      = \"FV_MAIN\"\n    INFComponent = \"SomePkg.SomeDriver\"\n    Token        = \"NEW_FEATURE_SUPPORT\" \"=\" \"1\"\nEnd\n```\n\n---\n\n## Validation Rules\n\n1. `INFComponent.Name` — unique across all SDL files\n2. `INFComponent.File` — path relative to Package root must exist on disk\n3. `LIBRARYMAPPING.Instance` — must be `\"Package.Name\"` matching an existing `INFComponent.Name`\n4. `FFS_FILE.INFComponent` — must be `\"Package.Name\"` matching an existing `INFComponent.Name`\n5. `FFS_FILE.FD_AREA` — must match an existing `FD_AREA.Name` in SDL\n6. `TOKEN.Name` — unique across all SDL files; `Master = Yes` only once per project\n7. `Token` condition names — must reference existing `TOKEN.Name` values\n8. `PcdMapping.PcdType` — must include full `\"Pcds\"` prefix\n9. `FFS_FILE.Apriori_Index` — must be a **quoted string**, not a bare integer\n10. GUID values — **never modify**; only reference or add new ones\n"
